## Reduction to a two-token chain

Let $x$ be the position of the number $a$ and $y$ the position of $7$. Each step picks one of the six edges uniformly, independent of labels, so $(x,y)$ is a Markov chain. The root shows $a$ exactly when $x=r$. The process stops when $y=r$, and $y$ starts at $F$ (where 7 sits). So $p(a)=P(x \text{ reaches } r \text{ before } y \text{ reaches } r)$.

Label the positions: $r$ (root), $A$ and $B$ (children of $r$), $C,D$ (children of $A$), $E,F$ (children of $B$). The edges are $rA, rB, AC, AD, BE, BF$.

## Symmetry

The tree automorphisms fixing $r$ (swap the two sides, swap $C\leftrightarrow D$, swap $E\leftrightarrow F$) reduce the unknowns to:

- $u=h(A,B)$
- $p_1=h(A,C)=h(B,E)$, the level-1 token and level-2 token on the same side
- $p_2=h(A,E)=h(B,C)$, opposite sides
- $q_1=h(C,A)$, $q_2=h(C,B)$
- $s=h(C,D)=h(E,F)$, both level-2 tokens on the same side
- $t=h(C,E)$, level-2 tokens on opposite sides

## Equations

Taking each transition with probability $1/6$ and multiplying through by 6:

- $6u = 1+2q_2+2p_2$
- $3p_1 = 1+q_1+s$
- $4p_2 = 1+2t+u$
- $3q_1 = p_1+s$
- $4q_2 = u+2t$
- $2s = p_1+q_1$
- $2t = p_2+q_2$

## Solving

From the last four equations, $q_1=\tfrac35p_1$ and $s=\tfrac45p_1$. Substituting into $3p_1=1+q_1+s$ gives $p_1=\tfrac58$, so $q_1=\tfrac38$ and $s=\tfrac12$.

The remaining system gives $q_2=\tfrac38$, $p_2=\tfrac58$, $t=\tfrac12$, $u=\tfrac12$. All seven equations check out.

## Required values

Starting from $y=F$:

| $a$ | start $x$ | value |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | $C$ | $t=\tfrac12$ |
| 2 | $A$ | $p_2=\tfrac58$ |
| 3 | $D$ | $t=\tfrac12$ |
| 5 | $E$ | $s=\tfrac12$ |
| 6 | $B$ | $p_1=\tfrac58$ |

$$p(1)+p(2)+p(3)+p(5)+p(6)=\tfrac12+\tfrac58+\tfrac12+\tfrac12+\tfrac58=\tfrac{11}{4}$$

The note from the other agent (48615/17848) does not match this result. Its value is about 2.724, while the derivation above gives exactly 2.75.

ANSWER: 11/4
